why: Top-stage check, stage 4c 2026-10-18: The source says only phase 1 (procurement programming and plan publication) is operational; tender-file management and electronic bid submission are still 'en experimentation'. No tender is published or bid online, and the figures (274 plans, 179 purchasing plans, users) are not tenders, value or share of purchasing.

Top-stage check, stage 4c 2026-10-18: The figures are supplier and procuring-entity registrations (9,900 suppliers, 380 PEs with accounts, 330 applications submitted or drafting), not tenders, value or share of purchasing through the system, so they do not meet the 'use reported' rule.
